vo.text: Read the push dialog properly before you send: two lists, two columns, and one count that matters.
vo.next_text: The button carries the number of enabled stations whose percent adjustment differs from what Lynx holds, leaving out any already pushed today.

vo.text: The button carries the number of enabled stations whose percent adjustment differs from what Lynx holds, leaving out any already pushed today.
vo.previous_text: Read the push dialog properly before you send: two lists, two columns, and one count that matters.
vo.next_text: It is disabled when nothing is queued, so a greyed-out button means there is nothing to review.

vo.text: It is disabled when nothing is queued, so a greyed-out button means there is nothing to review.
vo.previous_text: The button carries the number of enabled stations whose percent adjustment differs from what Lynx holds, leaving out any already pushed today.
vo.next_text: The left column is what Lynx holds now; the right is what will replace it.

vo.text: The left column is what Lynx holds now; the right is what will replace it.
vo.previous_text: It is disabled when nothing is queued, so a greyed-out button means there is nothing to review.
vo.next_text: Both name the station, so you are always comparing the same head across the row.

vo.text: Both name the station, so you are always comparing the same head across the row.
vo.previous_text: The left column is what Lynx holds now; the right is what will replace it.
vo.next_text: Available to Push comes first, ticked. Pushed Today follows, unticked, and is there to stop you adjusting the same head twice in a day.

vo.text: Available to Push comes first, ticked. Pushed Today follows, unticked, and is there to stop you adjusting the same head twice in a day.
vo.previous_text: Both name the station, so you are always comparing the same head across the row.
vo.next_text: That hold releases at midnight where the course is, not 24 hours after the push. Tick a pushed station only when you mean to.

vo.text: That hold releases at midnight where the course is, not 24 hours after the push. Tick a pushed station only when you mean to.
vo.previous_text: Available to Push comes first, ticked. Pushed Today follows, unticked, and is there to stop you adjusting the same head twice in a day.
vo.next_text: When a minimum threshold is set, the banner counts the stations it will rewrite.

vo.previous_text: That hold releases at midnight where the course is, not 24 hours after the push. Tick a pushed station only when you mean to.
vo.next_text: The affected rows show both the original and the value that will actually be sent.

vo.previous_text: When a minimum threshold is set, the banner counts the stations it will rewrite.
vo.next_text: The footer button names the number of ticked rows, and that is exactly what will be sent.
